posts.text:
Nearly #HamOrJam but we didn’t have ham in our cream tea… so just jam!

I put some jam on the pot lid & held it in front of the wasp as she circled our plates. She followed it back to the tray.

I think she’s Vespula vulgaris. Video of her enjoying the jam.

#WaspLove
@waspwoman.bsky.social
